title: Playboy: Making Love Series - Arousal, Foreplay & Orgasm

overview: From the world leader in sensual programming for couples, Playboy introduces the Making Love Series. Internationally renowned sex expert Dr. Ruth Westheimer presents an enlightening look at the art of making love that is both entertaining and informational. Combining erotic segments with candid and often humorous exchanges between Dr. Ruth and real couples, the program is a guide to total sexual satisfaction and happiness in you relationship.
